title: The Bad Beginning
author: Lemony Snicket
summary: After their parents die in a fire, the three Baudelaire children are placed with a distant relative, Count Olaf, who wants their fortune. The narrator warns readers throughout that the story will not be a happy one.
readIf: you like darkly funny children's books with an arch, bookish narrator.
skipIf: you want a cheerful story, because the misfortunes are the whole joke.

pairings.reason: Another story of smart children outwitting terrible adults, though with a gentler outcome.
Another dark, funny children's story that is a little scary in a good way.
An orphan with cruel guardians finds a stranger, kinder family.
